references.text: Flax is also mentioned in connection with the plagues of Egypt, where the flax was destroyed by hail.
The context for why Rahab hid the spies on the roof – they were sent by Joshua to scout out the land.
Rahab had already decided to hide the men before she brought them up to the roof.
Rahab and her family were spared because of her action of hiding the spies.
The result of Rahab's protection of the spies – she and her family were saved.
Rahab is mentioned as an example of faith because she welcomed the spies and hid them.
James uses Rahab as an example that faith is shown through deeds, including her action of hiding the messengers.
